verdict.rationale: The docs show recurring scheduling in natural language, with the example "each weekday at 9 AM Central for the next four weeks" [dots-docs-14]. The controls page confirms "future scheduled runs" exist and continue independently of Pause [dots-docs-22]. The dot runs in the cloud while your computer is off [dots-docs-2] and reaches out with results or decisions, including via Slack [dots-docs-1, dots-docs-6]. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of one-off tasks scheduled for a specific future time, documentation for viewing, editing or cancelling scheduled runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
